content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Ferozepur Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://ferozepur.dcourts.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Ferozepur Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Para Legal Volunteer posts is 05 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Para Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is passing the 10th standard examination. Additionally, candidates must possess knowledge of the Punjabi language.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Para Legal Volunteer position will receive a daily remuneration of Rs. 800.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the DLSA Ferozepur Para Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and submit it along with necessary documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Para Legal Volunteer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Para Legal Volunteer posts primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the verification of their submitted documents.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DLSA Ferozepur Para Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Para Legal Volunteer posts in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The Para Legal Volunteer positions are contractual in nature, meaning the employment is for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions of the recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the District Legal Services Authority Ferozepur located?
faq.answer: The District Legal Services Authority Ferozepur is located in Ferozepur city, Punjab. The specific address for application submission will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age limit criteria for the Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any minimum or maximum age limits for the Para Legal Volunteer posts. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for the DLSA Ferozepur Para Legal Volunteer recruitment is strictly offline. Online applications will not be accepted.
